openrouter.provider_statement: The Free Models Router openrouter/free has zero prompt and completion token pricing.

nvidia.provider_statement: NVIDIA states that Developer Program members get free access to NVIDIA-hosted NIM API endpoints for prototyping; provider-global documentation, key presence, successful authentication, or a credential fingerprint alone do not prove that one concrete credential/model pair is covered by that entitlement.
nvidia.credential_plan_proof: The exact non-secret credential fingerprint must have provider-side Developer Program/free hosted-NIM entitlement evidence, an observation timestamp, a digest of that evidence, and an explicit allowed-model list containing the requested model before autonomous FREE_ONLY network execution.
nvidia.scope: NVIDIA-hosted API Catalog/NIM prototyping endpoint only; no dedicated enterprise endpoint

groq.provider_statement: Groq Free and Developer are economically distinct tiers. Developer is pay-as-you-go, while Projects may set custom rate limits at or below organization ceilings. Therefore Free-like RPD/TPM response headers are quota telemetry and cannot uniquely prove that a concrete credential/project is zero-cost.
groq.credential_plan_proof: Require fresh provider-side evidence that the exact credential fingerprint belongs to a Groq account/project currently on tier=FREE with pay-as-you-go disabled, bound to a non-secret account/project scope and exact allowed model set. Matching documented Free-plan headers are corroborating telemetry only and never economic authority.

mistral.provider_statement: Mistral Free mode includes API usage; API keys themselves are not plan-scoped and can also use pay-as-you-go settings.
mistral.credential_plan_proof: Require provider-side Free-mode/pay-as-you-go-disabled evidence bound to the organization/workspace before autonomous calls. Ordinary key presence or HTTP 402 is insufficient.
